title: Migrate Your Documentation from Any Platform with One Command
summary: Migrate product docs, guides, knowledge bases, and API documentation to Theneo with AI. Switch from any platform, website, or local folder in one command.
body_markdown:
Moving your documentation to a new platform shouldn't mean copying hundreds of pages, rebuilding navigation, or fixing links one by one.


Whether you're switching documentation platforms, migrating a help center, or moving product guides stored on your computer, you can now **migrate your documentation to Theneo with one command.**


Introducing **` theneo migrate`** : an AI-powered way to move existing documentation into your Theneo workspace. No need to specify where you're migrating from or manually recreate every page.


## How to migrate documentation to Theneo with one CLI command


Open your terminal and run:


```text
theneo migrate
```


That's it. Your AI agent helps move your existing content into your Theneo workspace, taking care of content transfer, page organization, and other repetitive work.


You don't need to select a source platform, configure platform-specific flags, or copy and paste your documentation manually.


## Switch from any documentation platform to Theneo


Looking for a Mintlify alternative? Switching from GitBook, ReadMe, Document360, or Docusaurus? Moving product knowledge out of Notion or Confluence?


Your AI agent can help migrate content from those tools and other documentation sources. You don't need to tell Theneo which platform you're leaving. The important thing is that your agent can access the content you're moving.


## Migrate product documentation, user guides, knowledge bases, and API docs


Documentation migration isn't just for API references. Theneo can help you move different types of content, including:


- **Product documentation:** Feature explanations, onboarding guides, setup instructions, and product manuals.
- **User guides and tutorials:** Walkthroughs, how-to articles, and step-by-step instructions.
- **Help centers and knowledge bases:** Support articles, FAQs, troubleshooting guides, and self-service resources.
- **Developer and API documentation:** Technical references, integration guides, SDK content, and API specifications.
- **Internal documentation:** Team procedures, technical knowledge, and reference materials.


Whether you're moving a single set of product guides or consolidating several documentation sources, your agent can help organize them in Theneo.


## Move docs from a local folder, Git repository, export, or live website


You don't need an existing documentation website or Git repository to get started. Your AI agent can work with content from:


- **Local folders:** Markdown files and other documentation files on your computer.
- **Git repositories:** Documentation maintained alongside your code.
- **Platform exports:** Exported pages and documentation files from another tool.
- **Live websites:** Publicly accessible documentation pages.


As long as your AI agent can access the source material, it can help bring that content into your Theneo workspace. Private pages or content that isn't included in an export may require additional access or manual review.


## Preserve documentation structure and important links during migration


A documentation migration is more than copying text. Navigation, page structure, internal references, and existing links matter too.


With` theneo migrate` , your AI agent can help transfer content, organize pages, preserve important links, and flag anything that needs your attention. You stay in control while your agent handles the repetitive work.


Review the migrated pages before publishing. If public URLs are changing, configure redirects from the old paths to the new ones to help existing visitors and search engines find your content.


## Start migrating your documentation to Theneo


Whether you're replacing an existing documentation platform or turning a local folder into a published documentation site, getting started takes one command:


```text
theneo migrate
```


**Any documentation. Any accessible source. One command.**


[Follow the step-by-step guide to migrate your documentation to Theneo.](https://docs.theneo.io/get-started/migrate-to-theneo)


[Learn more about Theneo CLI](https://docs.theneo.io/developers/automation-and-dev-tools/theneo-cli)
